name: El Cerrito Police Explorers
what_you_do: Help the police and your town as a volunteer Explorer. Your Post does many jobs for the police and the town.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 18 with at least an average C grade or better in school. You can stay in the Post until your 21st birthday. A criminal record does not always block you, but every applicant gets a background check. The form has a line for a parent or guardian to sign.
pay_detail: Explorers donate at least 12 hours a month, counted every quarter. The department buys the uniform. You bring your own shoes or boots.
deadline_text: No application dates are stated on the program page or on the application form.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Police Explorers application, a PDF on the city website. Give three reasons you want to join. A parent or guardian signs it too. Every applicant gets a background check.
notes: The paper application has a line for a Social Security number. Ask the department why before you write it down, and never send it by email. The form has no date, so ask the department if it is the current one. The same page lists a paid Cadet Program for college students. It also lists Volunteers in Police Service for adults 18 and older.
